cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll tune your violin for the audition. I work by ear. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've tightened that string until it snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. That string couldn't hold pitch. I've saved you a failure onstage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The audition panel heard it snap. They're asking if you know what you're doing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I rejected an unreliable string. Ask for their spare violin; I'll check that one before I approve it.

mechanism: A protects a performance of expertise by confidently redefining mistakes and adopting B preferred helpers or safeguards before cooperation collapses.
confusable: Distinguish actual competence or merely boasting from obvious error covered by expert language; S02 must yield practical control to keep B trusting the performance.
comparison: Boiler bluff adapts to genuine engineer involvement; violin bluff adapts to performer protection after broken string.
seedUse: Canonical timer/engineer and snapped-string seeds supply exposed incompetence; S02 needs real compliance with B conditions rather than more unilateral checking.
